name: Intrinsic Appearance DDF (IADDF)
aliases: Path Tracing with Intrinsic Appearance DDFs (IADDF)
definition: A scene description combining a Directed Distance Field (DDF) for geometry with continuous Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) for appearance and lighting, allowing for differentiable rendering of intrinsic images (geometry, reflectance, illumination) from any viewpoint.
